# deskl.ink

> A desktop for you. A computer for your AI. Instantly available, browser-accessible Linux
> workstations operable by a human, an AI agent, many cooperating agents, or a human and AI
> together. Cloudflare-native — a workstation boots in seconds and scales to zero when idle.

deskl.ink gives you cloud Linux workstations (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian) in your browser — no local
install, no infrastructure to configure. Pick a size (Everyday 4 GiB · Developer 6 · Power 8 ·
Heavy 12) and a form: a **Desktop** (full graphical environment streamed over VNC) or a headless
**Server** (terminal-native — git, Node, Python, ripgrep, tmux, and a browser terminal). Every open
computer is a tab in one workspace; a ⌘K command palette, inline rename, live cost estimates, and a
one-click "stop everything running" keep it fast. Installable as an app, and the shell works
offline. It is built to be operated by people and by AI agents through the same control plane.

## Links

- [deskl.ink](https://deskl.ink/): the product — open a cloud Linux workstation in your browser.
- [llms-full.txt](https://deskl.ink/llms-full.txt): the complete knowledge corpus with full detail for AI ingestion.
- [Sitemap](https://deskl.ink/sitemap.xml): the public pages, machine-readable.

## Notes for AI agents

- deskl.ink is built to be operated by AI as a first-class user, not only by humans.
- It is a standalone product that owns its own workstation runtime, UI, and agent-control plane — not
  a plugin of another app.
